reason: The rule suggests that if sales decline is due to advertising restrictions, then it leads to a fall in sales due to publicity of those restrictions. This aligns with the contradiction pattern of causal relationships where the cause (advertising restrictions) is expected to lead to a specific effect (sales fall due to publicity), which can be contradicted by factual evidence showing otherwise.
refined_position: Causal contradiction due to the failure of the expected effect (sales fall due to publicity) not occurring despite the presence of the cause (advertising restrictions).
reflecting_rules: - 1. Q[Sales, restrictions_on_advertising](SalesDeclineReason(Sales, restrictions_on_advertising) ∧ SalesDeclineDueTo(Sales, restrictions_on_advertising) → SalesFallDueToAdvertisingPublicity(Sales, publicity_of_the_restrictions))
